column1: # Overrides for cjk_ja_fold, applied over OpenCC JPShinjitaiCharacters.txt (reversed) and Unihan
# kJapaneseNewVariant. Columns (tab-separated): old, new, reason, reference
# Each line is a reviewed pair that neither source holds. Measured on the 21 Japanese books of
# Project Gutenberg (509,622 kanji); the count is the old form's occurrences there. Unihan is cited,
# - 呑→吞: 呑 is the Japanese standard form; 吞 is the Chinese one.
# - 籐→藤 (rattan, wisteria), 炮→砲, 棹→櫂, 涌→湧, 譚→談: different words, or both forms in use.
# - 只→子, 捌→八, 肆→四, 愈→愉, 匈→胸, 晁→朝, 灬→火, 艸→草, 蕈→菌, 寔→實: Unihan semantic
#   variants that are not the same word in Japanese.
# - The 1956 書きかえ replacements, kept apart until a corpus shows the fold is wanted: 慾→欲,
#   歎→嘆, 煖→暖, 饑→飢, 廻→回, 盃→杯, 吊→弔, 泛→汎, 馭→御, 吃→喫, 澹→淡, 犇→奔, 糺→糾.
